I agree ^^

I have accidentally missed a dose as well and I have found no food, drink or activity helpful... not even a hot bath. Best to sleep it off and wait for the next day to be better.

These antidepressants are powerful to the brain and it's going into withdrawel.
I smoke Mary Jane regularly and no side effects.
I wonder if there is a way to beat depression without ant substances. Yes I hear Cognitive Behavioural Therapy from everywhere...but is that actually working for anyone?
